name: Autonomous Logistics Decision Agent with AI Route Optimization

values.content: =You are a logistics AI assistant. Explain why the selected routing mode ({{ $json.selected_mode }}) and route sequence were chosen. Consider: Fuel level: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').item.json.body.fuel_level }}%, Selected mode: {{ $json.selected_mode }}, Mode reason: {{ $json.mode_reason }}, Optimized route: {{ $json.optimized_route }}, Total distance: {{ $json.total_distance_km }} km. Provide: 1) A detailed explanation of the decision logic, 2) A brief summary (2-3 sentences).

options.instructions: You are an expert logistics AI that provides clear, concise explanations for routing decisions. Focus on efficiency, safety, and priority management.
